Hi,

Can the mental patient make an aggravated strike if opposing minion
plays an Immortal Grapple?
It does not say the patient can make a hand strike for +1 strenght
aggravated.

Escaped Mental Patient
Mortal with 1 life. 1 strength, 0 bleed.
As a (D) action, Escaped Mental Patient can enter combat with any
minion controlled by another Methusela. The Patient can strike for
strength +1 aggravated damage. Burn him or her at the end of combat if
he does so.

Thanks in advance.

Oortje
